map.公式原理是什么？: What is the principle behind the formula?
map.基于盐质量守恒 V1·S1 + V2·S2 = (V1+V2)·St，解出 V2: Based on salt mass conservation V1·S1 + V2·S2 = (V1+V2)·St, solving for V2, which is a linear mixture.
map.算出来 V2 为负怎么办？: What if the computed V2 is negative?
